title: Financial Statement Extraction
summary: A pipeline using pdfplumber to support structured extraction from financial statement PDFs.
overview: A document-intelligence pipeline developed at JHS & Associates LLP that uses pdfplumber to support structured extraction from financial statement PDFs.
problem: Financial statements are commonly distributed as PDFs, which are not directly usable as structured data. Extraction makes their contents available for downstream processing.
approach: Developed a financial statement extraction pipeline using pdfplumber to support structured extraction from PDF documents.
